host.description: Interface to bind the proxy to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for local-only, '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port on which the proxy listens for client connections.

http2.description: Enable or disable HTTP/2 protocol support (recommended to leave enabled).

ssl_insecure.description: If true, skip validation of upstream server TLS certificates (useful for testing with self-signed certs, but not recommended in production).

cert_gen.description: Directory where dynamically generated TLS certificates (for HTTPS MITM) are stored.

mode.description: Proxy mode. 'normal' = standard HTTP proxy (requires client proxy config), 'transparent' = intercepts transparently (requires OS routing rules), 'reverse' = reverse proxy, 'local' = local-only (no network binding).

reverse_upstreams.description: List of reverse proxy targets. Each entry forwards requests matching a pattern to an upstream URL.

name.description: Human-readable label for this reverse upstream (not used programmatically).

match.description: Hostname or path prefix to match (e.g., 'example.com' or '/api/v1').

server_replay.description: If true, serve responses from previously captured flows instead of contacting the real server (useful for deterministic testing).

client_replay.description: If true, replay recorded client requests against the upstream server (e.g., for load simulation).

web_host.description: Interface for the web UI (mitmweb). Set to '0.0.0.0' to expose it externally (with caution).

web_debug.description: Enable verbose debugging in the web UI (e.g., show full request/response headers).

save_stream_file.description: Path to a file where all intercepted flows are streamed in real-time (e.g., for offline analysis or integration with other tools).

transparent_proxy.description: For 'transparent' mode only — overrides automatic detection of transparency support (e.g., for OSes like Linux with netfilter).

bypass_hosts.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses to exclude from HTTPS interception (e.g., ['169.254.169.254'] to avoid metadata services like AWS EC2 IMDS).

addons.description: List of built-in or custom addons to load (e.g., ['anticache', 'stickyauth', 'stream_large_bodies']). See full list at https://docs.mitmproxy.org/stable/addons-overview/

connection_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for establishing connections to upstream servers. Increase for slow endpoints.
